# <span id="aanchor389"></span> Contact Type Editor

The Contact Type Editor is used to define the contact types that will be available in the Contact Type Selection screens for objects, such as Meters, Locations, Quality Sources, and Test Reports and Calibration Devices in TESTit Integrated V2.

Contact types are not supported for TESTit Integrated V3.

Contacts can be associated to Contact Types at the object level (e.g., meter, location, source), which enables the contact to receive automatic email notifications as exceptions or messages are generated.

<div class="example">

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

<div style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Example">

You can create a contact type called "Analyst" and enable it for use with meters and locations.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 496;height: 313;" />

You can then go to the Meter Editor or Location Editor, select a meter/location, and open the Contact Type Selection screen from the Tools menu to see the "Analyst" contact type. The Quality Source Editor would not contain the "Analyst" contact type, as it was only configured for meters and locations in the Contact Type Editor.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 368;height: 253;" />

From the Contact Type Selection screen, you can assign a contact name to the "Analyst" contact type. Each meter/location can have a different contact name, as well as zero, one, or multiple contact names assigned.

In the [Exception Description Editor](../Application/Exception%20Description%20Editor.md), you can define which exceptions or messages will trigger an automatic email to the assigned analysts using the Notify field. The contacts assigned for each meter or location will then be notified by email when exceptions or messages that are configured to notify are generated for the meter or location.

</div>

</div>

By default, FLOWCAL installs with two contact types, "Technician" and "Witness", which cannot be deleted. However, other contact types can be created manually from the Contact Type Editor or in bulk using FcLoader.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Contact Type Editor:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  Select **Contact Types** in the **Contacts** group.

Accessing the Contact Type Editor requires the "Contacts" privilege.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 489;height: 310;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Contact Type Editor Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following options are available on the Contact Type Editor screen:

- **Meter** - Contact type will be available in the Meter Editor.
- **Location** - Contact type will be available in the Location Editor, Liquid Cavern Editor, and Comparison Location Editor.
- **Quality Source** - Contact type will be available in Quality Source Editor.
- **TESTit** - Contact type will be available in Test Reports (TESTit Integrated V2 only).
- **Calibration Device** - Contact type will be available in Calibration Devices (TESTit Integrated V2 only).

</div>
